title: cfb 1.2.2 (SheetJS): Apache-2.0 whose only holder line is in the appendix, plus its inlined crc32.js

components.name: cfb
components.evidence: The package's LICENSE is Apache-2.0 whose only copyright line is the filled-in appendix 'Copyright (C) 2013-present   SheetJS LLC' (inside the licence body, so subtraction finds none); the shipped module cfb.js (sha256 239f7fb9d74b0cb8856e0b1a182bdf310f9fcf5b75a958e84edc158cd387dab2) opens with '/* cfb.js (C) 2013-present SheetJS -- http://sheetjs.com */' (comment markers dropped above). No NOTICE file in the package. The npm tarball (integrity = lockfile) unpacks identical to node_modules; registry gitHead ad93f76a36f893362efe96f738a327c290c1f2a9. Only cfb.js ships (research module log; third_party/notices/inventory.json at 1c2c92c, recorded from the current build, after the Miew and InChI trim, lists only node_modules/cfb/cfb.js for cfb@1.2.2, with this sha256); its require('fs') is behind get_fs() and the package's browser field maps fs to false.

components.name: crc32.js (SheetJS crc-32), inlined in cfb.js
components.evidence: cfb.js line 171 opens '/*! crc32.js (C) 2014-present SheetJS -- http://sheetjs.com */' and the copy sets CRC32.version = '1.2.1'. The crc-32 package itself is installed (1.2.2) but not shipped. Text: crc-32 1.2.1's LICENSE from its npm tarball (registry gitHead d64513c9525ff50dda0eeb538ed0535a61ae7243), byte-identical to the installed crc-32 1.2.2's; Apache-2.0 with appendix 'Copyright (C) 2014-present   SheetJS LLC'. Not in the plan's list of inlined copies; found here because cfb has no holder line outside its licence body.
